newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST-Bank/Portugal to leave rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Bank/Portugal to leave rates unchanged.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal will make no changes to its official interest rates when it announces terms for the next commercial bank reserve period on Tuesday, according to a Reuter poll of seven analysts on Monday.
The Bank will announce the conditions at 1415 GMT. The repurchase pact rate stands at 6.50 percent and the absorption, or drain, rate at 6.20 percent.
All seven agreed that the bank would not change rates, although they all also agreed that there is still room for rate cuts in Portugal.

The poll included the following banks and brokerages - IMF-Informacao de Mercados Financeiros, Siemca-Sociedade Mediadora de Capitais, Banco Portugues de Investimento, Banco Mello Investimentos, Fincor, Banco Essi.
